style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley 60cm Pre-Lit Red Berry & Pinecone Snowy Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Welcome guests in festive style with our indoor outdoor 60cm pre-lit red berry &amp; pinecone snowy wreath, a timeless Christmas decoration perfect for any front door or festive display. Lightly dusted with a snowy finish, and adorned with vibrant red berries &amp; pinecones, our pre-lit wreath brings a touch of winter wonder to any space. Warm white Micro LED lights are woven throughout the frosted greenery, casting a soft, magical glow that's perfect for creating a cosy, inviting atmosphere. Battery powered for easy placement, this wreath is ideal for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use - decorate doors, windows, mantels, or walls with ease. Whether you're refreshing your holiday décor or starting a new tradition, this elegant wreath is designed to bring festive charm to your home year after year.</p><ul><li>MAGICAL FROSTED FINISH: Lightly dusted with a snowy finish, this 60cm frosted wreath brings a wintry touch to your Christmas décor.</li><li>WARM WHITE LED LIGHTS: Soft, warm white LEDs create a welcoming seasonal glow - ideal for styling both modern and traditional festive settings.</li><li>BATTERY OPERATED FOR EASY PLACEMENT: No need for mains power - simply insert batteries (not included) and hang your wreath where you like.</li><li>INDOOR &amp; OUTDOOR DECORATION: Designed to suit both indoor and outdoor displays - style on your front door, garden gate, mantelpiece, or in your hallway, the choice is yours.</li><li>STYLISH: An elegant piece that can be used year after year - easy to store and effortless to style each Christmas.</li></ul><p><strong>Product Specifications:</strong></p><ul><li>Height: 60cm</li><li>Width: 60cm</li><li>Depth: 20cm</li><li>Weight: 1.2kg</li><li>Batteries NOT included - 3x AA required</li><li>No hanging hook</li><li>Size: ONE</li></ul>
